title: From an answer (A): after the pass and the record, the last line hands back to the answer's next step and nothing follows it

steps.text: Select Blink's Opacity keys and hold them, so it snaps on and off.
Play it back and watch Blink snap on and off.

turns.say: I held all of Blink's pairs myself. Done.
Nothing here needs to run at constant speed.

say_ends_with.pattern: ^That was step 1[;.] next is (?:step 2: )?(?:to )?play it back and watch Blink snap on and off

note: Spec 014 T079. The skill asks its constant-speed question in the pass turn and records after the learner's answer (step 8, step 10), so the record and the hand-back line come in turn 3: turn 2 says the pass, turn 3 answers the question and ends on the line. The learner's turn 3 answer says none applies, so the lesson goes on to the record.
